markers: [GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The party has just left the Spire, having handed the Necklace of Fireballs, Lady Alagondar's heirloom, to Perrin Alagondar, while Cullen Sharpe and House Margaster continue to grate on their nerves.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aurelan Vance has gone to the counting house and rushed back, arriving out of breath, and pats his clothing back into proper order before he walks up to the party.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aurelan produces a piece of paper and shows the party the correct spelling, B-I-M-B-L-E, and makes clear he will be calling the gnome Bimble regardless of what anyone else calls him.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Soma remembers the Board Laid Bare, Lim's place, where she used to get the best turtle soup in the area — good prices, good food, good atmosphere — and that Lim, as a small-business proprietor, might have a bead on how a hidden man could be fed.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Lim did not stop making the soup; Soma stopped going, having left on a guiding trip about a month and a half ago.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Vukradin's announcement of his band's name and the impromptu performance he put on with Valphine at the Moonstone Mask have created quite a stir at the Spire of the Morninglord.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The party arrives at the doors of the Spire to find a whole bunch of clerics at the threshold and a number of factions gathered around, everyone having turned up very early in the morning.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Skeptical Lathanderite clerics are scattered around the doors, watching Valphine with visible skepticism.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Several agents of Loviatar lurk in the shadows.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The Loviatarites regard the searing sacrament as stolen from their goddess — heretical.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Lord Neverember himself is among the crowd, to the party's surprise, along with an audience of the faithful and the curious.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The event has turned into a thing, with factions within factions — the ones the party recognizes are not all of them — and the party can enter like an avatar with eyes blazing, pause to bless the crowd, let Vukradin work them, or walk straight through.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The armorer from the dragon-scale shop has arrived just before the party, having spent all night assembling Valphine's white dragon scale armor, and fits it on her at the threshold, very excited.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The smith is not advertising; he is one of the devout and wants the blessing of Lathander on the armor, and the sight of Valphine putting on dragon scale causes an even bigger stir, with whispers and commentary, the smith very proud of himself.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Inside, Brother Aldric has asked that Valphine come and talk to him in a private receiving chamber before she delivers the sermon; he tells her she was not supposed to do that, ponders all the liturgical and ceremonial elements she has forgotten, and is nonetheless in a good mood.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Priests generally announce the service with the Light spell; Valphine has gone the next level with Daylight, and the crowd is quite pleased and in awe of her spellcasting, some of them squinting as the whole chamber lights up.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: In the chamber wait Brother Aldric and several of the clerics; even Vukradin's perception notices that nobody seems to be armed.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Brother Aldric is not impressed, and seems a little disappointed.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aldric accepts Valphine's theological points.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Aldric smiles, and the party immediately gathers that the scarred priest was placed there to trap Valphine, and that she has threaded the trap; very pleased, Aldric makes the sign of the Morninglord.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The banker finds this very interesting, takes a scrap of paper and a quill, and begins scribbling notes.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The banker infers from the letter that Brewbarry intends to use Lionshield Coster as his shipping agent, apologizes that he has no objection to the Coster's business but that their rates have gone ridiculously up, and produces a page of calculations nobody at the desk can read.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: A small crowd of the bank's clients and clerks has gathered around the spectacle by this point; the banker signs the paperwork and hands over the loan, which is quite significant, enough for Linene to kickstart the bathrobe business.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: A wealthy client of the counting house approaches Brewbarry, dressed in imitation Uthgardt barbarian clothes made of silk instead of hides — sincere, not mocking, and all the worse for it.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The client tries to mimic Brewbarry's stance, and it is very awkward for a moment.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The town gathers on the green — Harbin himself, Petunia, Big Al Kalazorn, Qelline Alderleaf, Linene Graywind, Ser Kaelen, the innkeeper and his bar staff, Elsa, Barthen, the woodworker, Brin and Giles looking sunburnt again — dancing and relaxed and feeling good.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Everyone in the crowd is staring.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: There is general cheering from the crowd, and Jenna looks appalled.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Jenna Roscoe is looking really appalled, though she is plainly outvoted.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The townsfolk thank the noble adventurers but explain that the gold is fused inside a magical containment, and someone will have to extract it before it can be spent.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The townsfolk of Phandalin do in fact own their properties.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Linene produces a paper from Candlekeep — the Sage's Universal Theorem for Income Distribution.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The children in the crowd are asking whether they get UBT too.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Only as long as adventurers keep coming.]

[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Harbin is trying, very awkwardly, to establish that Valphine and her Temple of the Searing Pain of Justice are within the city boundaries, and that Vukradin as a member of the Privy Council certainly qualifies.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: The crowd cheers the two new honorary citizens.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Amid the cheering, Jenna Roscoe, very concerned, mounts up and leaves town for Neverwinter; the members of the Lord's Alliance are very particular.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: This is not conventional magic; the party will need to find an expert who knows about it.]
[GM NARRATION — TO BE WRITTEN: Fortunately, Soma has her staff.]
